note: DNB's fee information form, the one its terms page links to (dated for 2025, printed March 2026): keeping a payment account costs nothing, nor does internet and mobile banking. The form is an image, read by eye. Read again by eye 2026-10-30 (the same image form, dated for 2025): the adult's card, Pluss bankkort, is 295 kroner a year; withdrawals at any minibank with BankAxept are free, with Visa (abroad) 40 kroner; a currency surcharge of 1.99% on purchases and withdrawals abroad; overdraft interest 20% a year; a payment abroad outside SEPA 60 kroner (SEPA 30); an instant payment to another bank above 5,000 kroner 75 kroner (an ordinary domestic payment isn't priced on the form, so none is written). Not stated: a returned payment, interest, what opening asks.
